title: THE PISTON · SQUAT CLOCK
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · leg stations, flat legs, every 3:00 for 8 rounds
why: Upper two of the last three days, so today is all squat pattern (quads last loaded 08-26). Same run-interleaved arc, new clock: every 3:00 you lift, run, and bank whatever rest is left.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles + knees + hips

items.name: Ankle rolls in the squat ×10/side · knee drives ×10/side
Belt 5.5 mph @ 0% · 2 min
items.detail: then set it to 7.5, it stays there all block

blocks.title: THE PISTON · 24 MIN · E3MOM
blocks.meta: 8 ROUNDS · EVERY 3:00 · 4 STATIONS × 2 · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · 35 lb
blocks.format: EVERY 3:00 · station, then RUN LEG, rest until the next 3:00 · count rounds made on the clock
blocks.workRest: Every round exits onto the belt: RUN 0.20 mi @ 7.5 / 0%. Belt stays at 7.5 the whole 24 min. Rest = whatever is left before the next 3:00.

items.name: R1 · Double front squat 2×40 lb ×6 + swing 40 lb ×12 → RUN LEG
R2 · Front-rack split squat 2×40 lb ×6/side + Cossack squat 35 lb ×5/side → RUN LEG
R3 · Front-rack reverse lunge 2×40 lb ×5/side + single-leg hip thrust ×10/side → RUN LEG
R4 · Bulgarian split squat 50 lb ×8/side + swing 40 lb ×15 → RUN LEG

blocks.noteGreen: Log rounds made on the clock (8 = target), your shortest rest, and RPE.
blocks.text: ★ COSSACK — wide stance, sit all the way onto one heel, other leg straight, toes up. ★ SINGLE-LEG HIP THRUST — shoulders on the couch, one foot down, other knee to chest, drive the hips up. ★ BULGARIAN — rear foot on the couch or a stair, bell in the hand opposite the front leg. ★ RUN LEG — belt is already at 7.5; straddle the rails, step on, quick feet.

items.name: Bear crawl 10 yd out + 10 yd back
items.detail: knees an inch off the floor
